0.description: Clients who use their card regularly, with above-average bills and above-average payment amounts, and almost no late months.
0.recommended_action: Retain and grow: eligible for credit-limit increases, rewards and cross-selling. Standard monitoring.
0.key_traits: median credit limit NT$150,000; median average bill NT$33,790; 0.2 late months out of 6 on average

1.description: Clients who barely use their card (very small bills, many months with no activity) despite having the highest credit limits. They pay most of what they owe, but about 1 in 3 had at least one late month.
1.recommended_action: Activate and verify: usage campaigns, but review any sudden jump in spending, since the default rate is close to the portfolio average.
1.key_traits: median credit limit NT$180,000; median average bill NT$967; 0.4 late months out of 6 on average

2.description: Clients with low credit limits who use a large share of their limit and are late on payments in most of the last 6 months; they pay only a small part of what they are billed.
2.recommended_action: Act early: freeze limit increases, contact for repayment plans, prioritize in collections and review the case manually.
2.key_traits: median credit limit NT$50,000; median average bill NT$28,073; 4.0 late months out of 6 on average
